narrator.name: Narrator
narrator.note: Tells the story of the beginnings: measured, solemn, unhurried.

lamech-father-of-noah.name: Lamech, father of Noe
lamech-father-of-noah.note: Son of Mathusala in Seth's line (not Cain's Lamech): a weary, hopeful father naming his son.

1.t: This is the book of the generation of Adam. In the day that God created man, he made him to the likeness of God.

2.t: He created them male and female; and blessed them: and called their name Adam, in the day when they were created.

3.t: And Adam lived a hundred and thirty years, and begot a son to his own image and likeness, and called his name Seth.

4.t: And the days of Adam, after he begot Seth, were eight hundred years: and he begot sons and daughters.

5.t: And all the time that Adam lived, came to nine hundred and thirty years, and he died.

6.t: Seth also lived a hundred and five years, and begot Enos.

7.t: And Seth lived after he begot Enos, eight hundred and seven years, and begot sons and daughters.

8.t: And all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years, and he died.

9.t: And Enos lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.

10.t: After whose birth he lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and begot sons and daughters.

11.t: And all the days of Enos were nine hundred and five years, and he died.

12.t: And Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Malaleel.

13.t: And Cainan lived after he begot Malaleel, eight hundred and forty years, and begot sons and daughters.

14.t: And all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years, and he died.

15.t: And Malaleel lived sixty-five years and begot Jared.

16.t: And Malaleel lived after he begot Jared, eight hundred and thirty years, and begot sons and daughters.

17.t: And all the days of Malaleel were eight hundred and ninety-five years, and he died.

18.t: And Jared lived a hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Henoch.

19.t: And Jared lived after he begot Henoch, eight hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

20.t: And all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years, and he died.

21.t: And Henoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Mathusala.

22.t: And Henoch walked with God: and lived after he begot Mathusala, three hundred years, and begot sons and daughters.

23.t: And all the days of Henoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

24.t: And he walked with God, and was seen no more: because God took him.

25.t: And Mathusala lived a hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.

26.t: And Mathlusala lived after he begot Lamech, seven hundred and eighty-two years, and begot sons and daughters.

27.t: And all the days of Mathusala were nine hundred and sixty-nine years, and he died.

28.t: And Lamech lived a hundred and eighty-two years, and begot a son.

29.t: And he called his name Noe, saying:
This same shall comfort us from the works and labours of our hands on the earth, which the Lord hath cursed.

30.t: And Lamech lived after he begot Noe, five hundred and ninety-five years, and begot sons and daughters.

31.t: And all the days of Lamech came to seven hundred and seventy-seven years, and he died.

32.t: And Noe, when he was five hundred years old, begot Sem, Cham, and Japheth.
